guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul / Gibson ES-175 / Telecaster
guitar.evidence: Slash's Gibson Les Paul (famously a Kris Derrig replica used on Appetite for Destruction) is iconic; Izzy Stradlin's rhythm work on Telecaster/other guitars is also documented.

tone.target: dirty slash-style hard rock crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.profile: dirty slash-style hard rock crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain using a Boost for initial grit, followed by the Distortion model to achieve gnarly crunch. This is paired with the UK 45 amp and UK Vintage 4x12 cab for classic hard rock tone, finished with minimal reverb for space.

rig.name: Guns N' Roses - Nightrain - Valeton GP-180

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, high-gain 4x12 model to better capture the raw, dirty hard rock sound.

proposals.recommendedAsset: high-gain British 4x12 IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback/V30 style)
proposals.reason: The current IR is too clean; a dirtier, more aggressive cab will enhance the raw hard rock crunch.
